tools.name: get_ifc_elements
tools.description: List IFC elements by type. Use to inventory model or locate by GUID.

type.description: IFC type, e.g., IfcDoor, IfcWall, IfcBeam, IfcPipeSegment, IfcFlowSegment

tools.name: check_exit_door_width
tools.description: Check exit door width compliance against HK FS Code 2011 Table B2. Returns per-door measured vs required.

min_width.description: Minimum clear width in mm. 750 for 4-30 persons, 850 for 31-200 persons.

tools.name: detect_clashes
tools.description: Detect geometric clashes between structural and MEP elements via BVH tree. Returns pairs with penetration.

tools.name: get_element_properties
tools.description: Get Psets/Qtos and placement for a single element by GUID.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated compliance summary (score, pass/fail counts, clashes).
